name: Baked Potato & Cheddar Cheese Soup
groceryIngredients: Peeled Russet or Yukon Gold Potatoes
whyItWorks: Peeled potatoes simmered and blended with aged sharp cheddar create a rich, soothing starch base with minimal mechanical friction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at Animator's Palate with no raw green onions/chives on top. If flaring, ask for no bacon bits and take a Lactaid pill for the cream base.
watchOuts: Raw sliced scallions / chives on top
Dairy cream base if lactose sensitive
